map.由存货与营业成本求存货天数 使用指南: Inventory Days from Inventory and Cost of Sales User Guide
map.存货周转天数(DIO)计算器，输入存货余额与年营业成本，按 DIO=存货/营业成: Inventory days (DIO) calculator: enter the inventory balance and annual cost of sales and compute the inventory cash-conversion cycle as DIO = inventory / cost of sales x 365, to optimize inventory management.
map.DIO = 存货/营业成本 × 365: DIO = Inventory / Cost of sales x 365
map.输入存货余额与年营业成本，求存货周转天数。: Enter the inventory balance and annual cost of sales to get inventory turnover days.
map.衡量存货从入库到售出平均占用多少天，评估库存效率。: Measures the average number of days inventory is held from receipt to sale, assessing inventory efficiency.
map.季节性行业备货时，测算存货天数避免积压或断货。: When stocking up for a seasonal business, estimate inventory days to avoid overstocking or stockouts.
map.对比同业，识别自身供应链管理优劣。: Compare with peers to identify strengths and weaknesses in your supply chain management.
map.：某公司期末存货 300 万元，年度营业成本 3600 万元，存货天数=300÷: : A company has closing inventory of 3,000,000 CNY and annual cost of sales of 36,000,000 CNY; inventory days = 300/(3600/365) = 300/9.863, about 30.4 days, meaning inventory turns over about every 30 days.
map.由净利润、折旧摊销与营运资本变动求 OCF: OCF from net profit, depreciation and amortization, and working capital changes
map.存货天数越短越好吗？: Are fewer inventory days always better?
map.通常越短资金占用越少、跌价风险越低，但过短可能频繁断货、丧失销售；需结合安全库存: Usually shorter means less capital tied up and lower markdown risk, but too short may cause frequent stockouts and lost sales; combine it with safety stock and the replenishment cycle.
map.用营业成本还是营业收入？: Use cost of sales or revenue?
map.存货对应已售商品的成本，故用营业成本（COGS）更匹配；用收入会混入毛利，高估周: Inventory corresponds to the cost of goods sold, so cost of sales (COGS) matches better; using revenue mixes in gross margin and overstates turnover efficiency.
